description: Two analogue bidirectional switches, with a button, a control input and a manual reference voltage each

params.text: In the up position the switch changes state for as long as the gate or button is held; in the LATCH position each rising edge or press flips it and it stays there
Flips that channel's switch by hand, lighting while the second state is active; in momentary mode holding it inverts the logic of the switch control input
Sets a manual voltage, -10V to 10V, normalled to the second jack of channel A, so the switch can select between a patched signal and a fixed voltage

inputs.text: The signal passed to the A output while the switch is in its first state
The signal passed to the A output while the switch is in its second state; unpatched it carries the voltage set by the reference trimmer
The signal the second switch sends to one of its two outputs
A gate or trigger flips that channel's switch

outputs.text: Carries whichever A input the switch has selected
Carries the B input while that switch is in its first state
Carries the B input while that switch is in its second state
